data.name: Hakan
data.gender_notes: Hakan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Turkish word 'hakan' which means 'wise', 'intelligent', and 'powerful'. In Turkish mythology, Hakan was a name given to the leader of the tribe or a wise and powerful man. In Arabic, Hakan is transliterated as 'Hakim' which means 'wise, judge, and learned'. The name Hakan carries the meaning “Brave, strong, and powerful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Turkish, Arabic. Parents who choose Hakan usually hope their child will grow to embody brave, strong, and powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hakan total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
